snippet.title: Log Away - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Rekindle your inner self in Log Away, a cozy sandbox game. Build, furnish, and decorate your dream log cabin amid nature’s beauty, from shores to mountain peaks, across varied seasons and weather. With limitless creativity, unbound by time or resources, enjoy solitude among wildlife and dear pets.

Coming This Summer on PC!

Play the demo now and wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468400/Log_Away/

Official website: https://the-mark.com/works/63/log-away/

Soundtrack composed by Chris Haugen.
